source_pins.native_context_note: Initial P04-14 working context and HEAD retained above. Root committed during this audit; all18 final committed file bytes match the initially inspected working hashes. No build/runtime credit is supplied by this audit.

menu.default_binding: Meta+5; SWT.MOD1 means Ctrl+5 on Linux, Command+5 on macOS. Locale/platform keybinding overrides remain possible.
menu.mac_menu_note: Classic macOS menu construction puts these Tools entries under View instead.
menu.dispatch: Gets the main MDI and calls showEntryByID(StatsView.VIEW_ID), with no Transfers datasource. Menu maintenance eagerly builds the always-built Tools items so the accelerator is not dependent on first opening the menu.
menu.different_entrypoint: Status-bar rate-label double-click explicitly selects TransferStatsView; do not attribute that datasource to Tools/Ctrl+5.
menu.backend_effect: Navigation only; no transfer, cancel, reset-mark or statistics-file write is dispatched by the menu listener.

view_lifecycle.close_reopen: The main MDI factory creates a closeable entry. Existing entry activation reuses it; after normal outer close the retained factory can create it again. Generic close listeners may veto; StatsView declares no special permanent-entry veto.
view_lifecycle.deactivate: Outer view sets destroyOnDeactivate=false. Its embedded MDI sets destroyEntriesOnDeactivate=true for subview instances.
view_lifecycle.periodic_update: StatsView creates a daemon update thread that signals EVENT_PERIODIC_UPDATE to entries approximately once per second; TYPE_REFRESH updates the selected entry. Delete stops the thread loop flag and disposes its parent.
view_lifecycle.inner_x_scope: The small embedded top-right x directly calls StatsView.delete/disposes its parent; this audit does not equate that implementation detail with the outer MDI close transaction.
view_lifecycle.native_requirement: Ctrl+5 and tab close/reopen must preserve existing transfer work. A view close must never mean Cancel or application Quit.

conditional_details: IPv4: main DHT, main DDB Graph, main Vivaldi.
IPv6: IPv6 DHT and Vivaldi; IPv6 DDB Graph only when IPv4 is absent.
IPv4: BiglyBT DHT; BiglyBT Vivaldi additionally on CVS builds. Commented-out CVS registrations do not create tabs.
subviews.fresh_default: With fresh embedded-tab configuration and no plugin reordering, Activity is the first selected subview. Tools does not force Transfers.
subviews.plugin_scope: Core registration is guarded once; plugin views can be added. Stable core-before-plugin sorting and saved tab state mean exact visible tab set/order is not universal.
subviews.transfers_inner_default: tsv:tabfolder.sel defaults to 0 (Current); previously selected History can be restored.

counter_domains.activity: Samples actual global-manager data plus protocol byte rates, along with protocol, configured limits and swarm-average series. Saved totals are not graph samples.
counter_domains.transfers_now: GlobalManagerStats current data/protocol receive/send rates; underlying rates are bytes per second.
counter_domains.transfers_session: GlobalManagerStats session cumulative data plus protocol byte counters; OverallStats session uptime uses the instance's current-time start, not a saved start field.
counter_domains.transfers_total: OverallStats downloaded/uploaded/uptime getters called with since_mark=true. Mark time controls the displayed since-date label; mark counters still affect subtraction when mark_time is zero.
counter_domains.history: Separate LongTermStats service, with period selection and resolution. OverallStats saved totals and per-download saved records contain no equivalent history samples.
counter_domains.display_units: Underlying byte counters/rates are separate from formatting. DisplayFormatters has configurable SI/IEC labels, 1000/1024 scaling, bits for rates and format overrides. Uptime is seconds; mark time is epoch milliseconds.
counter_domains.other_current_panels: Connections, routing, queued uploads, SOCKS, autospeed capacities/pings and DHT/cache/tag/country services need actual owned service inputs; no native saved-library proxy is available.

saved_overall_file.authority: core/src/com/biglybt/core/stats/transfer/impl/OverallStatsImpl.java at the pinned commit, plus Constants, GeneralStats and FileUtil
saved_overall_file.basename_expression: Constants.APP_NAME + .statistics; APP_NAME defaults to BiglyBT and can be overridden by the original product-name system property. A first fixed-default reader must not silently rename it BiglyBTC.statistics.
saved_overall_file.format: Plain resilient bencoded root dictionary containing the all dictionary. This path uses BEncoder/BDecoder, without gzip.
saved_overall_file.field_type: Each writer field is a Java Long represented as a signed bencode integer. Raw signed values and presence/type should remain inspectable.

fields.meaning: Accumulated global transfer data plus protocol received bytes
Accumulated global transfer data plus protocol sent bytes
Mark label timestamp; not last-save timestamp
Accumulated global transfer protocol sent bytes
Accumulated global transfer data sent bytes
Accumulated global transfer protocol received bytes
Accumulated global transfer data received bytes

saved_overall_file.do_not_sum_twice: downloaded/uploaded already combine the global-manager data/protocol counters. DHT values are stored independently; do not add them or the split fields into those combined totals as a new client total.
saved_overall_file.stale_comment: OverallStatsImpl's sizes-in-MB comment is contradicted by byte-valued counters and the GeneralStats API; the stored byte fields are not megabytes.
saved_overall_file.source_load_defaults: getLong returns zero for absent/null all map, absent field or non-Long field, and retains any supplied signed Long. The direct all-to-Map cast can throw for a wrong-shaped all value. Missing/invalid whole-file reader results may become empty maps in Java.
saved_overall_file.recommended_native_difference: Expose raw optional values, type/default diagnostics and missing/error provenance. Do not present a missing or corrupt file as an observed zero total. If source-default zero is projected for an absent individual field, retain explicit default provenance; invalid/negative arithmetic can independently remain unavailable under a reviewed native policy.

mark_operations.setMark: Sets mark_time to current epoch milliseconds and copies current downloaded/uploaded/uptime baselines.
mark_operations.clearMark: Sets mark_time and the three mark baselines to zero, without resetting lifetime totals.
mark_operations.since_mark_getter: If baseline exceeds total, first lowers the in-memory baseline to total, then returns total minus baseline. This is independent of mark_time. A read-only snapshot can derive admitted nonnegative since-mark values without mutating the original document, with normalization provenance.
mark_operations.no_first_scope_writer: No Set Mark, Clear Mark, reset, recovery rewrite or total accumulation in the initial read-only implementation.

saved_overall_file.save_cadence: Nominal 60-second timer, save every tenth completed tick (10 minutes), plus forced update at destroyInitiated. Clock reversal, rejected time delta, write failure or abrupt exit can prevent saving; neither a shutdown-save guarantee nor freshness can be inferred.
saved_overall_file.no_core_startup_required: A pure bounded bencode projection of generated bytes or a fixed-leaf native read-only adapter can inspect saved values without Java, Core, GlobalManager or normal manager startup.
saved_overall_file.prohibited_shortcut: Do not instantiate OverallStatsImpl or StatsFactory.initialize for a fixture/reader: they register global providers, lifecycle listeners and periodic timers, and initialize other stats services.
saved_overall_file.read_only_io_prerequisite: Current native ConfigFile::load accepts safe .config names only. BiglyBT.statistics requires a separately reviewed fixed-leaf read-only adapter over the existing held directory fd/detail::readFile; do not widen the generic writer's allowlist.
saved_overall_file.recovery_scope: Original FileUtil recovery may try .saving/.bak, partially recover, make bad copies and rewrite primary from backup. The new reader must disclose its chosen complete-document candidate precedence and provenance and perform no original recovery side effects. Existing native reader ordering is not automatically complete original FileUtil equivalence.
saved_overall_file.ownership_bounds: Proposed immutable owned Document with ordinary 4 MiB/100000-node/depth64 limits, exact default basename and exact allowed suffixes only, stop checks around read/projection, unknown fields retained. Current parser rejects duplicate dictionary keys; that compatibility limit must remain explicit.

native_available_inputs.saved_library: SavedDownload.downloaded/uploaded become LibraryItem.received/sent. Original GlobalManager export stores each download's lifetime data-only counters, not global protocol totals or this-session values.
native_available_inputs.library_scope: At most 100000 accepted model records; duplicate hashes are allowed while duplicate keys are not. A saved-library summary must count records and report nonnegative known-field coverage, independently for received/sent; it must not silently deduplicate by hash.
native_available_inputs.unknown_and_overflow: Initial not-loaded, successfully loaded empty, absent field, negative raw field and checked-sum overflow are distinct. No absent values become zero. A complete loaded empty record set can have a genuine zero sum.
native_available_inputs.filter_scope: Use accepted source-model records, rather than currently visible proxy-filter rows, for an explicitly labelled saved-library summary.
native_available_inputs.rate_input: LocalProgress publishes actual per-torrent libtorrent torrent_status download_payload_rate/upload_payload_rate, throttled with steady_clock to roughly 200 ms. It is a single owned local-transfer payload domain, not original GlobalManager data-plus-protocol or all-client traffic.
native_available_inputs.telemetry_scope: Target/revision-bound UI telemetry can provide observed transfer rates. It has no recorded history timestamps; any bounded native chart must sample actual arrival/monotonic times and explicitly describe its local preview/payload scope. No zero samples before an event or fictitious preexisting history.
native_available_inputs.notification_scope: Authoritative snapshots may change saved counters; accepted telemetry updates columns1..5 and details0..3. A summary need not rescan100000 rows for every telemetry/detail change. No performance result is claimed here.
native_available_inputs.current_gaps: No native OverallStats/BiglyBT.statistics reader, global session counters, global protocol rates or LongTermStats service exists in the inspected source.

implementation_recommendation.navigation: Add Tools > Statistics (Ctrl+5), a single closeable known page, activate existing page or reopen after close; Ctrl+W/X close only the view while busy. Keep torrent targets suppressed while Statistics is current. Do not dispatch transfer/cancel/refresh merely for activation.
implementation_recommendation.first_useful_transfers: Read-only Last-saved overall totals (fixed BiglyBT.statistics reader), independent saved mark and lifetime facts with units/provenance/unknowns; a separate Saved library records summary with coverage. Never substitute the latter for original Total or This Session.
implementation_recommendation.first_activity_choice: A useful Activity subview can show actual observed local-transfer payload rates/series with explicit scope and no-sample state. Exact original global Activity remains open until a real global service exists. Root chooses whether to select Activity first for original navigation or Transfers first as an explicitly documented preview adaptation.
implementation_recommendation.unavailable_services: Keep session/protocol-global/history/connection/autospeed/cache/DHT/tag/country metrics unavailable until corresponding owned inputs exist; no fake zeros or fabricated graphs.
implementation_recommendation.generation: Statistics IO must use its own nonzero session/request generation over the existing held worker lease, reject stale completions, remain independent of saved-service/layout active-pending tokens, and publish result before busy=false with QObject deletion/queued cancellation guards.
implementation_recommendation.details: No torrent-state/payload scan, per-torrent startup IO, filesystem stat of payloads, ordinary Java manager, new profile lease or network request is required for saved global projection.

proposed_independent_tests: Ctrl+5 from My Torrents filter/Files/service controls, singleton tab, Ctrl+W and X during idle/busy, close/reopen without transfer/cancel/selection retargeting.
Not loaded versus loaded-empty library, partial known counters, negative raw counters, independent overflow, duplicate hashes and filter independence.

Generated overall bencode fixtures covering all13 fields/units, unknown fields, missing/wrong all, wrong individual types, negative values, mark>total, mark_time0 with nonzero marks, independent metrics and checked arithmetic.

Fixed-leaf read-only reader: true missing, primary/backup/saving provenance, malformed candidates, unsafe symlinks, size/node/depth caps, stop/stale/deletion gates, byte/inode identity and no rewrite.
Actual telemetry target/revision checks, no-sample state, bounded event-driven payload-rate samples, close/reopen lifetime, no original global/history claim.
Any future Java equality evidence needs a separately approved inert exact-body source probe; these proposed synthetic tests give no Java execution/equality credit.
